reference_role: approved material/light/camera style, no HUD or entities
refinement_prompt:
Edit input image 1, preserving its beautiful warm cream-sandstone palette, natural painterly paving, upper-left sunlight, three-quarter near-isometric game camera, tribal redrock identity, seamless unified ground/perimeter, and broad open exits through left/right middle. This is a production game environment background without HUD or entities.
Recompose ONLY the perimeter scenery so it is markedly LOWER and THINNER: all masonry, tents, tusks, bone fence and redrock masses lie entirely OUTSIDE the central normalized rectangle x=0.11 to0.89, y=0.13 to0.87. That rectangle must be PURE WALKABLE GROUND, with only tiny weeds and subtle paving seams, no architectural silhouette and no foreground obstruction. At the north edge move the small tribal canopy and tusks upward close to the top border; ONLY their lower 8-12%-high section appears at the very top. It's natural for upper background structures to extend out of the image frame. Similarly move lower corner redrock and fence closer to very bottom, remove the tall dark woody/tree clutter, and keep a wide bottom-center sandy opening. At left/right edges narrow the existing organic rocks, making broad exit openings near y=0.45. The court fills ~78% width and ~74% height so runtime can accurately map gameplay onto it. Be very disciplined about that empty rectangle.
Keep irregular natural ecological edges merging into pale ground, not a rectangular frame. Only sparse very small indigo flags remain far at edges, do not line up repeated tusks. No solid-color bands, no flat rectangular wood borders, no tiling or mirrored stamp, no sun disk/mandala/rings. Preserve the calm pale beige/cream floor as the dominant color, restrained terracotta paving accents and fresh sage vegetation in the thin outer border. No saturated all-orange floor. Do not introduce any standalone interactable objects, drums, crates, animals, people, HUD or words. One whole full-bleed painting, high resolution landscape3:2, no atlas.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished production game environment BACKGROUND PAINTING, covering the entire floor and organically integrated map perimeter. This is NOT an atlas, NOT a contact sheet, NOT a mockup, NOT a UI image.
Output one high resolution landscape 3:2 image, ideally 3072x2048. Opaque full-bleed painting. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED GAMEPLAY LOOK for materials, warm light, hand-painted cartoon fantasy and near-isometric camera only. Remove ALL characters, enemies, HUD, lettering, portrait, skill badges, quest icons, pickups, crystal beacons and interactive props from that image. Those will be drawn separately by the game. Do NOT reproduce its central sun circle.
Paint a cheerful sunlit ORC/OGRE REDROCK TRIBAL COURT from a high three-quarter near-isometric camera, nearly orthographic, no horizon/sky strip. Same camera orientation, crisp gentle illustrated outlines and 2.5D physical thickness as approved reference.
The MAIN FLOOR must be PALE CREAM-GOLD SANDSTONE, light warm beige and ivory with restrained ochre undertones. Most of the view remains light and quiet, so existing character sprites will read clearly. Terracotta appears only as occasional paving accents and around natural perimeter rocks; blue/indigo appears only in a few small distant flags/cloths. Fresh desert vegetation provides a little green. Avoid blanket orange/red saturation. Warm sunlight from upper left, short believable shadows, fresh welcoming mood.
IMPORTANT COMPOSITION: center ~78% of width ×74% of height is one large spacious WALKABLE courtyard, normalized rectangle roughly x .11 to .89 and y .13 to .87. Completely open, no objects inside that rectangle. Give the floor natural nonrepeating handmade details: broad irregular light sandstone slabs in quiet loose groupings, local seams, worn sandy patches, tiny occasional sage weeds near seams, subtle weathered discontinuous tribal chisels. These marks are hand-painted and organic, NOT a procedural concentric circle, repeated tiled grid, mirrored stamp, mandala, thick path graphic or swirling pattern. No big rectangle planes, no slab extrusion. Shape and scale of slabs vary gently without busy patchwork.
The outer ~8-12% of the painting is continuous NATURAL TRIBAL ENVIRONMENT painted as one whole with the floor, all four edges harmoniously blended. At upper edge, a short uneven terracotta tribal wall emerges from layered sunlit sandstone ledges, a few sparse curved ivory tusks are integrated into the architecture, and one small muted indigo tribal shade tent. No repeated row of identical segments. At right upper/lower corners, naturally varied rounded redrock shelves with sage desert shrubs and small sand grasses. At lower edge, low grass, worn broken stones and sparse short bone/wood fence remnants grow organically from sand, with no solid straight border. At left edge, a different low sandy rock shelf and sparse vegetation, not a copied right edge. The floor transitions naturally through sparse stone fragments into warm sand/rocks/roots around the perimeter; there must be no color stripe marking the transition.
LEAVE BROAD OPEN EXIT GAPS through BOTH LEFT AND RIGHT MIDDLE edges, each at least ~20% image height, connected smoothly to the clear court. There may also be a modest bottom-center opening. Do not enclose it in an unbroken wall. Avoid tall foreground silhouettes that hide gameplay. The boundary scenery is outside the playable rectangle and should never eat into central battle space.
Paint stone shelves with proper natural 3D sections; walls have lovingly painted low masonry, not a floor texture lifted vertically. No detached foreground sprites stamped around the rim. Every boundary and plant must feel part of the same beautiful environment illustration, with continuous sunlight, shadow and material transitions. Some asymmetry, unique side ecology and varied silhouettes, absolutely no identical repeated props forming a neat row.
No interactive standalone drums, torches, target dummies, crates, camp furniture, beacons, monsters or people: runtime will place those exact gameplay items separately. Only integrated background architectural/ecological detail at edges. A few small distant flags and one small boundary tent are permitted.
Avoid: any text, any HUD, people/enemies, pickups, opaque pure-color horizontal bands, repeated tiled orange-yellow floor, uniform saturated orange arena, programmer-drawn decorative rings, repeated identical border objects, hard rectangular plank walls, stretched floor texture on walls, giant gray rim, huge square pools/pits, internal chasm, dark gloomy palette, visual clutter, contact sheet, transparent cutout atlas.
